title: Trump's DOJ gains oversight of OpenAI’s green-card employee sponsorships | TechCrunch
summary: The DOJ alleged that OpenAI and Statsig broke provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) by not truly looking for qualified U.S. citizens for these jobs before pursuing permanent residence applications (PERM) as the INA requires.
